home.title: Asenfar-ik n ssya, ger ifassen yelhan
home.lead: Ama tessaɣed, tzenzeḍ neɣ tkerrzeḍ, Akili tettɛawan-ik di yal amecwar s useɛdi udmawan akked tmusni n ssuq adigan.
home.aboutP1: Akili d takebbanit n ssya i gettɛawanen imdanen akked yimahalen deg isenfaren-nsen n ssuɣ, zzenz akked kerray. Nessen akal: yal taddart, yal anaw n uɣerbaz, yal amecwar n tnezzut. Tamusni-agi, nettaɛamed fell-as deg usenfar-ik, s yimeslayen iclayen akked umsaway yellan seg umeslay amezwaru alamma d usingem.
home.aboutP2: Tarrayt-nneɣ tefsus: a ken-nesmeḥses, a nefhem lebɣi-k ssaḥiḥ, a k-d-nefk tifrat yemmlalen deg amḍiq n tebdart tamatut n ismal.
home.featureSaleText: Zzenz neɣ asuɣ s talwit, s aɛawen ummid alamma d usingem.
home.featureRentText: Akerraz yelhan, axxam yelhan: nekni i gettɛasen amtawi akked uḍfar.
home.featureEstimateText: Azal ameɛqul n uɣerbaz-ik, s lmend n tmusni n ssuq adigan.
home.featureAdviceText: Tiregwa ifsusen akked imeslayen iclayen, seg usenger alamma d usingem.
home.ctaTitle: Tesɛiḍ asenfar n ssya di uxemmem-ik?
home.ctaText: A d-nemmeslay fell-as. Agraw-nneɣ ad d-yerr s zrib.

assistant.title: Amɛiwen n Akili
assistant.subtitle: Tiririyin s zrib i yesteqsiyen-ik
assistant.greeting: Azul! Amek i zemreɣ ad k-ɛawneɣ? Fren asteqsi ddaw-a.

buy.a: Wali tabdart n ismal-nneɣ, sakin sit ɣef « Sker asuter ɣef uɣerbaz-agi » deg usebter n uɣerbaz i k-yeɛǧben. Amsawal ad ak-d-yerr i wakken ad theyyim tirza.

sell.a: Ačar tiferkit « Zzenz aɣerbaz » s yisallen igejdanen (anaw, taddart, tiddi, azal). Ad ak-d-nerr i wakken ad nektil aɣerbaz u ad t-nheyyi i zzenz.

rent.a: Ismal n kerray ttbanen-d deg tebdart s « Akerray ». Ur tufiḍ ara ayen tettnadiḍ? Glem-aɣ-d ayen tebɣiḍ, ad ak-d-nsumer ismal yemmezgen.

estimate.a: Ih, nettaktil aɣerbaz-ik s tmusni-nneɣ n ssuq adigan. Nermes-aɣ i wakken ad nesbadu asarag.

documents.q: Anwi isemlen i ilaqen i zzenz?
documents.a: S umata: takarḍa n timagit, arra n tilin (neɣ adlis n wakal) d isemlen n uɣerbaz ma llan ɣur-k. Amsawal ad ak-d-yini tabdart s telqey.

services.a: Zzenz d usuɣ, akerray, aktil d uɛawen n tnezzut: ad k-neḍfer seg tirza tamezwarut alamma d usingem.

nin.a: Uṭṭun n timagit tanamurt yeǧǧa-aɣ ad nissin yal amsaɣ s telqey u ad nḥrez tiregwa. Yettwaseqdac kan i ufaylu-k.

contact.a: Aru-yaɣ-d s tferkit n unermes neɣ nermes-aɣ srid deg WhatsApp, ad ak-d-nerr s zrib.
